messages:
jas: kicking off a short experiment: trying a lightweight sentinel approach for funcall boundaries on the new ember-ptq model. want to see if a non-breaking delimiter reduces parse failures without major infra changes.

nora: what's the sentinel format? something simple like `<<JSON-BEGIN>>` / `<<JSON-END>>`?

jas: prototype uses `--BEGIN_JSON--` and `--END_JSON--` on their own lines. model prompt instructs to wrap the toolcall payload with those markers. runtime will strip lines outside markers and attempt parse.

eli: pros: we can extract reliably with simple line-scan and ignore kvprefix noise. cons: prompt reliance and potential model hallucination of markers or duplication. also clients/logging might need small parsing updates.

jas: agreed. plan: 1) small canary (1k samples) via ember-ptq-sentinel route. 2) runtime extractor as fallback only when parse fails: scan for sentinel blocks -> if exactly one block parse that -> else fall back to existing heuristics. 3) telemetry fields: `sentinel_seen`, `sentinel_count`, `sentinel_parse_ok`, `repair_method`.

nora: how do we avoid markers appearing in user-generated content or kv-prefix merges? if kvprefix injects text `--END_JSON--` accidentally that could be bad.

jas: we'll choose a low-likelihood marker (unicode arrow + string) like `↦BEGIN_JSON↤` / `↦END_JSON↤`. also runtime will verify block validity with a quick JSON probe before trusting.

eli: good. also add a safety: if sentinel-based parse succeeds but the extracted JSON is > 10kb different from original suffix, tag as `sentinel_suspicious` and require manual review.

ci-bot: job queued: job/ember-sentinel-3505 (1000 samples) -> https://ci.redwood/job/ember-sentinel-3505

jas: initial prompt snippet we'll try: 
"Please output the function call and its JSON arguments wrapped exactly between the markers ↦BEGIN_JSON↤ and ↦END_JSON↤. Do not include any extra text outside the markers. The content between markers must be valid JSON."

nora: slight worry: quantized model might still omit markers or place them mid-token. add a parser to tolerate common tokenization splits: accept markers with optional space/newline variants.

eli: add unit tests: marker lost, marker duplicated, marker inside string, marker broken by whitespace. ensure extractor doesn't accidentally pull text from outside markers when markers missing.

jas: metrics to capture from canary: parse_failure_rate, sentinel_hit_rate, sentinel_success_rate, repair_latency_ms, fallback_to_text_percent. We'll compare ember-ptq sentinel vs ember-int8 baseline.

ops-bot: note created: INF-CR-3587: ember sentinel probe and runtime extractor.

ci-bot: job started: job/ember-sentinel-3505 -> running

ci-bot: job finished: job/ember-sentinel-3505 -> success (1000 samples). summary: parse_failures baseline int8=4/1000 (0.4%), ember-ptq without sentinel previously=28/1000 (2.8%), ember-ptq with sentinel now parse_failures=6/1000 (0.6%). sentinel_seen=650, sentinel_parse_ok=618, repaired_by_sentinel=56, fallback=6. repair_latency_median=48ms,p95=190ms. dashboard: https://ci.redwood/dash/ember-sentinel-3505

nora: nice delta. sentinel reduced failures a lot and repair latency is small. any false positives (marker appeared but JSON invalid)?

jas: ~32 sentinel blocks failed the JSON probe (sentinel_seen=650 vs parse_ok=618). we tagged them as `sentinel_invalid` and applied further heuristics (ndjson split/trim). of those, 20 were recoverable by ndjson -> added to repaired_by_other. 12 ended up fallback.

eli: good to see. next steps?

jas: propose short roll: make sentinel extractor opt-in per-route behind FF, add unit tests and client parsing snippets for SDKs. also run a longer 100k sample canary across other ptq variants.

nora: also add `marker_entropy` metric to detect when models start inventing markers as part of content; alert if marker appears in >5% of responses where it's not expected.

ops-bot: flagged INF-CR-3587 for product discussion about adopting sentinel as official contract.

jas: I'll open PR with extractor code + tests + telemetry keys, and a docs note for SDKs. tagging @sam for review.

sam (out-of-thread): please ensure SDKs fail gracefully if they see markers and can't parse.

jas: noted. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4451 (sentinel extractor + canary infra). will follow up with longer canary results.
